statement.description: Libo is the training club built for real life — home, gym, office, or anywhere in between. No excuses. Just results.

features.headline:
Everything
you need.
features.description: 718 exercises · 140 workouts · 4 challenge programs. Every training format, from barbell strength to breathing and morning routines.
features.exerciseLibraryDesc: 718 exercises — 411 gym, 258 home, 49 mobility. Every one with equipment notes, muscle targeting, and form cues.
features.workoutLibraryDesc: 140 pre-built sessions — gym, home, cardio, stretching, morning routines, and challenge programs. 5 to 60 minutes.
features.programsDesc: Multi-week structured plans designed to get you real, measurable results. Follow the plan, trust the process.
features.progressTrackingDesc: Log every set, rep, and weight. Libo remembers your history and shows exactly how much you've grown.
features.customBuilderDesc: Build your own workout from the full exercise library. Set your sequence, sets, rest time — save and reuse.
features.moneyChallengesDesc: Join 30-day challenges, hit your daily reps, share to stories — and win real cash. 50 pushups a day for 30 days? That's €15 in your pocket.
